proposal.inferred_root_cause: gateway-layer fault reported as gateway_error while wallet:paytm itself is healthy
proposal.reasoning_trace: wallet:paytm is healthy on the rolling window at 92% success over 148 attempts against a 91% portfolio baseline, and the only open notice names wallet:phonepe, a different issuer on the same method. The issuer is answering normally, so a gateway-scoped code with no supporting telemetry is a thin claim: it is the most likely reading, not a confident one. The open notice on wallet:phonepe is a different issuer and explains nothing here. Attempt 2 failing identically rules out a one-off switch error. This is a recurring debit, so RBI's 24-hour cooling window is longer than any backoff this class would justify: the timing is set by regulation, not by the hazard estimate, and the pre-debit notice has to go out before the retry does.
